object.attr: analysis: an uncaught fault would otherwise exit 1, which reads as "documents have problems" and sends the person to search the documents (CF-C30, review Q27). A file that can't be read is a load error, not a fault.
object.description: If a fault stops mellon-check before each document is checked, mellon-check shall exit with status 2, whatever check problems were found before the fault.
